title: FetchURLParams
description: Fetch one http:// or https:// URL from the machine running nocx. The request is direct, never through a terminal pane's remote host, and only bounded UTF-8 text is returned.

url.description: The complete web URL to fetch.

result.title: FetchURLResult
result.description: The complete UTF-8 response text returned by the fetch.url assistant tool. HTML is retained as markup rather than being lossy-extracted; oversize responses are refused, so a successful result is never silently short.
